title: Tolomeo Gallio, Cardinal of Como → Anselmo Dandini, nuncio in France: letter partly in numeric cipher with its contemporary decipherment

folio_note: 12 canvases. cc. 3-4 address leaf with summary; c. 5 headed 'Cifra con lei di Como di 4 aprile 80' (the decipherment); c. 7 about 20 lines of digits mixed with clear words.
status: Record: 'Lettera parzialmente cifrata. In allegato un foglio d'indirizzo con riassunto dei contenuti (cc. 3-4) e la decifrazione del testo cifrato (c. 5).' why: Another 1580 Secretariat-to-nuncio cipher with the clear text attached: a check on Lasry's frame and one more letter key for the 1580 series.
verify: Transcribe the c. 7 digits, align with c. 5, compare with the targets/dandini1580 key.

title: Sigismondo Lodron → Ferrante Gonzaga, two letters partly in cipher, deciphered between the lines
shelfmark: Biblioteca Estense Universitaria, Modena, Autografoteca Campori, Lettera L, Lodron Laterano, Sigismondo, cc. 1-3 and cc. 4-6
folio_note: Cipher runs inside the clear text on 1r (one run, glossed 'Ferrara'), 1v (about 6 lines), 4r (4-5 runs), 4v (6-7 runs) and 6r (2-3 runs): about 15 runs, roughly 200-250 signs. Most runs carry a contemporary decipherment written above them; several on 1v, 4r, 4v and 6r have none.
status: Records: 'Lettera parzialmente cifrata (ma decifrata in interlinea).' Not in Dan's data. Manifest uuid(s): 56f7c9f3-6083-4ee1-bd3b-4628f3e25569, 767e3b8d-82f8-4aeb-b4bf-0c869a06f627. Worked by WAINUT on 3 Nov 2026, not solved: pairs located, key started. Signs look like Latin letters (a d e g l m o p x y z), a long s, a double-crossed sign and an E-like sign, not at face value. Two pairs seen by eye ('Don Diego' over 8 signs, 'In Conclavi' over 12 signs) do not fit one simple substitution, so the system is probably homophonic with syllable or null signs. Glossed runs name Salviati, the conclave, 'Don Diego' (presumably Hurtado de Mendoza), Duke Ottavio and the bishop of Pola, which fits Dec 1549. Two machine transcription passes could not be blinded (the gloss sits in the ascender zone of the cipher) and disagree widely; neither is usable. Not the ercole1544 half-shift; the ferrante1549 table does not give 'Don Diego'. A transcription job, not a break.
why: Two letters in one key with interlinear clear; small but complete.
verify: Transcribe each run sign-first on full-size crops, pair it with its gloss, freeze a key on one letter and test it on the other.
score_note: Scored from the Lodovico record and a low-resolution look at the scans during the Nov 2026 Estense sweep (research/wainut_leads_2026-11-03/)
